text:
maria: Heads up — CI is red for the sample app release. typegen regendiff is huge and the release bot auto-marked a minor bump. anyone seen why?
ci-bot: sample-app / unit-tests failed: 12 failed. regendiff artifact: https://ci.internal/redwood/regendiff/3032101111 :x:
aj: I pulled the regendiff. changelog generator picked up loads of changed `examples` in the OpenAPI spec which pushed the semver heuristic over the minor threshold. but these are example-only changes. :facepalm:
kevin: also seeing the Go SDK compile fail because typegen reordered optional params in one client method — sample app imports now break with: `../sampleapp/main.go:45: ambiguous selector client.Foo` (simplified).
zoe: long-term: we need stable-sorting in typegen and changelog should ignore example-only diffs. semver heuristics must not treat example-only changes as API surface change. :+1:
maria: quick repro snippet from my run: ```
$ ./scripts/regenerate.sh openapi.yaml
Regendiff: openapi.json -> openapi.regen.json
-  components.schemas.User.properties.name.examples: ["Alice"] -> ["alice"]
-  paths./v1/foo.post.requestBody.content.application/json.schema.properties.filters: order changed
```
aj: short-term proposal: revert the ordering change in the Go generator (restore stable property order), add a changelog filter config like `ignore: ["examples", "x-.*"]`, and treat example-only diffs as patch for semver tool. i'll sketch a PR.
ci-bot: release-bot has held the publish. staging canary blocked until a patch lands.
kevin: i'll open a focused PR to make property iteration deterministic in the Go typegen (WIP). @zoe can you pick up the changelog filter and semver tweak? worried about parity across SDKs too.
zoe: yes — i'll add the `ignore` config and add a unit test to changeloggen so examples don't surface. also will add a semver unit that ignores `examples`/`description` noise.
maria: let's aim for a patch (patch the automation) to avoid minor bump. if we can't land within 2 hrs we revert the semver automation and rerun the pipeline.
aj: :eyes: coordinating revert plan if needed. PRs: https://github.com/redwood/typegen/pull/421 (WIP), https://github.com/redwood/changeloggen/pull/99 (WIP).
kevin: FYI the auth/retry flaky tests we saw yesterday were amplified by nondeterministic backoff seeding; i'll add a deterministic seed for the integration test so reruns are stable.
zoe: great — merging the changelog filter + typegen stable-sort + semver tweak should unstick CI. i'll follow up with a short playbook note in #devex about how the semver automation decides bumps. :thumbsup:
